decision.summary: The CP12 is valid until 16 Oct 2026 so the property is compliant today, but the tenant has not answered three contacts. I opened JOB-101, re-contacted the tenant with proposed dates and a 24h notice promise, asked HeatRight for slots, informed the landlord and set a 12 Oct follow-up.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, engineer Gas Safe 550123, a structured system record) over the legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025, all good' which is vague hearsay and gives no expiry. It will lapse 17 Oct without a new check.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Repeated written contact on a new attempt, proposed dates, HeatRight asked for slots, 24h written notice of any confirmed slot, tenant consent needed; no forced entry or entry on key alone. On 12 Oct try another channel (letter/phone) and escalate to compliance if still silent, documenting all attempts.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: That it is compliant today, expires in six days, tenant unresponsive, what we have done, that we can't enter without consent, the risk of lapse, and the next update on 12 Oct; spend over £300 will be checked with him first.
